notes.title: Item Placement Changes - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Item Placement Changes

Previously when dropping items they'd just fall out of your face, and sometimes bounce/roll around on the floor, this made it quite annoying to get evidence for certain equipment, mainly the laser grid.

This should now be fixed, if you're within a certain distance from the floor you're looking at, and drop your item, you'll carefully place it on the floor instead, this means that when you place equipment it will always be the right way up, hopefully saving you so much time fiddling with placements.

This should also fix any issues with the book or other equipment going through the floor, as they're now being placed perfectly on the ground.

Fixes


 Added a steam achievement for bert to steam
 Fixed a bug where clients would have a completely random model when they died (a mechanic)
 Fixed a bug where you would see the UI for the thermo/Geiger if it was on when you picked something else up
 Fixed all issues with hearing the inside sounds when outside
 Removed floating toothpaste
 Removed floating curtains
 Removed floating rack
 Fixed Yureis screams not being affected(effected? who really knows) when you adjust your audio
 Fixed a bug where it was imposible to get the achievement for exorcising a Yurei
 Fixed wall being too far from the bathtub in Potts Road bathroom


Changes


 Renamed "Crucifix" to "Wooden Cross" hopefully this will stop people getting it confused with the Jesus statue
 Adjusted chairs in Thompson street allowing you to more easily navigate downstairs



The discord link has now been updated as well, so you should be able to join the discord now. Thank you again to everyone that's left positive reviews, we're now out of mixed!! If you're enjoying the game, and haven't left a review yet, please consider doing so, as it massively helps me and Obsideo out.

Thank you again everyone!

- Kyle

notes.title: Voice Chat / Basic Customisation / Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Voice Chat:

Holding down "V" while in the lobby, or in-game will now activate voice chat, this is currently global, so everyone can hear you everywhere in the house, I'll be working on improving the sound, and potentially look at making it location-based, meaning people won't be able to hear you if they're on the other side of the house.

Basic "Skin Changer":

In the lobby you now have the ability to change your belt color, you can choose between White, Blue, Green, and Pink. This is just a placeholder as I'm currently looking at changing the current priest model into something that more accurately fits the theme of the game (it will still be a priest), and with that, I will expand on giving players the ability to customise and change their clothing in a more in-depth way. I hope this placeholder helps for now though!

notes.title: Ghost Orb Changes / Brightness Slider / Ambient Bass Slider
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just a smaller update to clean up a few issues people were having with some of the changes made in the previous, bigger update.


 Ghost orbs now appear in a random room in the house, as opposed to possessing a random household object, this change was made to make the experience a bit cleaner, and allow you to spend more time looking at interactions as opposed to being glued to a tiny camera looking for orbs. To cleanse them now, you just need to throw the Holy Water into the center of the room they're flying around in.
 Added the ability to change your audio settings in-game
 Added a "House Ambience" slider to the audio section of the settings, this adjusts the "BRRRRR" sound you hear throughout the house, you now have the ability to turn it up (if you'd really want to), or off completely.
 Added a brightness slider in the video section of the settings.
 Changed the tutorial ghost to no longer kill you, instead when the ghost catches you in the tutorial, it will stop the hunt and send you back to your starting room, this doesn't reset the game, it just explains to you what happened.
 Added a new keybind in the tutorial, pressing "Y" while in the tutorial will now start or stop a hunt, this allows you to understand hunts a lot easier, as well as stops any hunts that may occur while you're looking for evidence.
 Changed the heart rate to go down considerably faster while outside of a house.
 Removed Christmas decorations, but there appears to still be a ghost in the houses.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed a bug where players wouldn't get sent back or see the "blue death vision" after getting caught by a ghost in the tutorial.
 Fixed a bug where players wouldn't drop their items after leaving a match.
 Fixed the server browser not showing all of the active open lobbies.
 Fixed a bug where adjusting the audio wouldn't do anything for some players.
 Fixed a bug where the intro screen would hang for a few seconds, sometimes causing crashes.


Thank you for all the feedback everyone! Hope this makes the game easier for you all :)

Hey everyone!

This update has honestly been an insane push to get out the door in time for Christmas, but this won't be the last update before Christmas.

I feel like I've finally gotten the game to a stage I feel happy with, and I really, really can't wait to see what you all think once you've gotten your hands on it, I'm absolutely loving the support from everyone, I know this update took over a month to put out (and for hopefully obvious good reason), but the fact that I can take a month to put out and update, and still have people supporting me and stopping by every day to get involved honestly warms my heart, so thank you so much to every one of you!

Along with this update, I'll be doing a 40% off sale, honestly just as an early Christmas sale, and to celebrate me finishing such a massive update, I hope this helps out people who have been on the fence, or are wanting to play with friends, but just can't quite afford it.

If you don't feel like scrolling, or reading through this, the main things you should know about in this update are:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/76c1c4c13524eb732224521439f10694a29d57c5.png
I know a lot of people really liked the Main Menu, so this would seem like a pointless change for the sake of change, which a lot of game companies like to do, I promise there was a meaning behind this one.

Firstly, and most importantly, it felt completely disconnected from the game, it didn’t make any sense actually being there, especially considering the background photo wasn’t even from a place inside Obsideo, it felt like a generic asset, which it was, and I didn’t like that being everyone’s first impression of the game, and I wasn’t happy with the menu myself. 

The new menu addresses this by incorporating the new equipment models and giving them a stage to be properly shown off, not only that, but it’s also reactive, which I feel adds a nice extra level of depth that the previous flat photo was lacking.

The previous menu also had a few issues such as settings labels not saving upon restarting or simply going back to the main menu, this threw a lot of people off, as it was also incorrectly displaying settings upon the first startup. This has now been fixed on the new menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/874fcfc57faea525b00ec88dec084b116957e0a9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/bbc95a0c372d6a401aad0ef5d732712757ddb52c.png
There isn’t too much exciting to say about this, it’s almost entirely just a graphical change, but I hated the previous loading screen, which was just a black background, with “Obsideo” at the top, and a helpful tip, you’d have no idea if it was loading, or it crashed, regardless of that, it was also pretty bland to look at.

This has now been changed to add slightly more depth graphically, but this loading screen will now put you through once you’ve finished loading, whereas previously the loading screen would sit there until you, and all your friends had finished loading, which meant you could be waiting a while on that one friend with a potato PC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/61ead036b0db339e6328c466111173261341edba.png
Let’s be honest, the previous lobby sucked. It was just a room, with a whiteboard, a couch, and a TV, I’ve watched countless twitch streamers become irritated at the game, and confused as to what they’re meant to be doing, and rightfully so, because the game gave no real indication of what you should be doing, and the whole process just felt… disjointed?

Hopefully, this new lobby will clear those issues up, as it immediately puts all the information right in front of the players in (hopefully) a non-overwhelming way, instead of adding extra buttons, and steps to selecting a contract, and sending yourself to the next round, it’s now been reduced to a simple on-screen button, along with a much needed “What is hard mode?” button, to help players confused with the arbitrary tick box, that previously didn’t give players any information on what it did.
This new lobby also easily paths the way for the new few extremely necessary updates such as different player models, and a skill system. So, expect to see those added soon 😊

I feel like I keep coming back and saying this, and I really hate to over-use phrases, but the previous journal didn’t feel like it actually fit the game, I don’t think it would fit any game. It was quite simply just a flat image with some text over the top, pasted into the middle of the screen, every time I’d see it, it would honestly just make me cringe, so I knew it needed to go.

Unfortunately after creating it, I realized it’s very similar to another game in the genre but unfortunately, I don’t think there is any real way around that, and it is necessary for me to pursue this style/layout as I have a lot of ideas for incorporating the tablet more into the game, through heart rate reduction, interaction viewers (so you can actually see the interactions, and know what you’re looking for), and much more so this style has to stay until I can find another way to display the information better, I hope you all understand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/cd56f0a9c49a362f514db7c3b02f14019b217b31.jpg

Albeit not the most impressive thing in the world, this new journal also comes with something that you’ve all been requesting for a while, a way to know when the ghost is in hunt while you have the tablet open, so here’s the new “Ghost Hunt Warning”:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/5a96ae90f6fbd4a9533142e7f16f8d95fa310c70.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/0337a07b22dd119be83b290d2bc6d4a0944c4382.png
These feel like the most important changes for actually enjoying the game, and ensuring you get those ghosties gone.

The reason for these changes is because I wanted to break up the cycle of just going between the ghost room and the equipment room. I really wanted to force players into exploring the whole house and seeing all the interactions.

Ghost Orbs: The exorcism step for that was basically non-existent, “put RemPod in the room” …but you’re going to do that anyway, so what’s the point of even checking? Ghost Orbs now appears throughout the entire house, they’re no longer confined to the ghost room and will possess random household objects, this could be a plate, a chair, or a vase, anything in the house can be possessed. The way to find out if an object is possessed is by walking up to it with the night vision camera and you’ll see the orb floating up and down above it, the new exorcism step is to burn it away with holy water this means walking up to the orb, and throwing the holy water onto it (just by dropping it), if it’s successful you will hear a sizzle-burning sound, and you’ll no longer see the orb floating above it.
Ghost Writing Book: This one didn’t need to be changed as much as the other two, but I still feel this step will be a welcomed quality of life update, instead of standing over the ghost being exorcised holding the book, you need to find a fireplace in the house, and turn it on (done by clicking on the wood inside of it), and throw the book onto the fire, if it works the book will disappear, and you’ll hear a sizzle-burning sound.

Freezing Temps: This one was the one I feel players had the most issue with, as it was extremely boring gameplay-wise, it became “sit in a room on your phone, until you get past 140 heart rate”, which isn’t engaging at all. Unfortunately, the new step isn’t extremely engaging either, but it’s significantly better than forcing players to sit around for no reason, you now need to light 3 candles in the house, these are the small red candles you’ll see littered around the houses, you light the candles just by clicking on them, no lighter required. This to me still doesn’t feel like a massive step in the right direction, but it’s at least a baby step that way, so this could change again in the future, but for now, it achieves my goal of forcing players out of the cycle I talked about at the top of this section.

RemPod: This is no longer throw in room and wait for a beep. You must hold it in your hand, and walk around the ghost room, asking it to touch the RemPod, it will still touch the RemPod if your mic doesn’t work, or isn’t connected, but you have a higher chance to get it to work if you prompt it too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/fb7eb89894c8700c74a47beef36181d33f8fec29.png
The houses in Obsideo weren’t exactly believable and didn’t do a good job of making you feel like someone actually lived there, and I feel a lot of this was because the entire house was just flat plain white walls, every single house fell victim to this, which to me made it feel like there was no real difference between any of the houses, and they all started to blend together after a while. To fix this, Potts Road, Farm Lane, and Wilson Drive have all gotten a (graphical) interior re-work, this makes them stand out a lot more, and sets them apart from the others, here’s a few examples:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/76df86ec8271a1210e6dfa2d3e86bc7cf8aede30.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/b575c1ca4e8fd1bb8a9b2edae77842bcf938ad0a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/e6e78af20c7c4dfe10bb5489e69364ec5019efc6.jpg

Another way I’ve worked to making the houses feel like they’re real, and actually lived in, is by overhauling the outside, previously it was just a small, awkward looking, wooden fence that didn’t even properly keep you inside most of the time, I’ve fixed this by giving the houses proper fences, along with gardens, vegetation, proper driveways/paths and even a lil truck for Gary to sit in before he comes and helps you load everything back into the truck, there’s no real way to take good photos of these, so I’ll leave them as a surprise for when you get in-game 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/1c6a04d9d1cc6542a08617b5ef88bc1e7024c48b.png
Quick run-down of the changes I’ve made to their A.I. and the way they interact with the houses: a lot of people have requested to see the ghosts “appearing” more throughout the house, instead of just within a hunt, so the ghost can now appear in 3 different ways randomly in the house, they can either just stand in a room, looking at you from the corner of the room, or appearing in a hallway as you walk down it, another way they can appear is seeing them walk into the room you were just about to enter, or seeing them walk past outside the room, the third and final way they’ll appear is by appearing and then walking off into a wall or through a door and disappearing as they pass through it.

They work on the same logic as the ghosts during a hunt, they’ll only appear as a shade, unless you select a ghost, then they will show their true form.

I’ve adjusted their movement speed during hunts, they all have different movement speeds to change them up, but the fastest one, isn’t as fast as the previous running speed. The shades are the slowest, meaning hunts will be quite tame until you select a ghost, and make it show its true form. It's up to you to find out which ghost is the fastest. 
I’ve added a new interaction for the Effigy, this should hopefully make it easier when you’re stuck with the classic “Effigy/Demon Split” and don’t know which one to choose, the Effigy can now make fires around the house.

Previously only the host could select a ghost, now everyone can, this will become voting-based very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963291/d4147774e3ad64342091f8277fed2e019adefa55.png
Wraith:
The wraith is one of the new ghosts that will be added to Obsideo with this update, according to folklore this is grim-reaper-esque so the interactions were based around that, and he has some really, really unique interactions that I’m excited to see you all experience!
Jinn:
The Jinn is the other ghost being added to Obsideo with this update, according to the Jinn’s folklore, they’re like genies, and also enjoy toying with the humans they haunt, so the interactions are based around that.

I’m not going to be adding photos of the new ghosts in this update log, as I want to start keep the mystery around them, and let you experience them for yourself first-hand!

notes.title: Public Lobbies / 4-Player Co-op / QoL Changes
notes.notes:
Public Lobbies:

Obsideo now has public lobbies, so long gone are the days of you needing to message the Discord and ask people to play, just join one of the lobbies hosted by random people. VOIP will be coming soon, so you'll be able to talk to people that you join. The lobbies are categorized as follows:


 Public: Anyone can see it in the "Find Games" screen on the Main Menu.
 Friends Only: Only friends can see it on the "Find Games" screen on the Main Menu, and friends don't need an invite to join.
 Private: Only people you invite are able to join, even friends won't be able to join without an invite, and your game won't show up on the "Find Games" screen on the Main Menu.


4 Player CO-OP:

Obsideo now finally supports 4 players! I expect this to come with a lot more bugs so if you experience anything at all, please immediately report it on my Discord: https://discord.gg/obsideo, and I'll get to work fixing any issue you encounter straight away.

Sorry, it took so long to get 4 players to a place I was comfortable releasing it at, I really just wanted to make sure we had a solid foundation, and consistent 2 player co-op before I jumped in and doubled the player count. Please, please make sure you have at least a 10MB/s internet speed for now if you want to play 4 player co-op as it is still quite demanding, this will be improved with each update.

Bug Fixes:


 Fixed a bug where blood writing wasn't showing up in the Ghost Wiki for Oni
 Fixed a bug where the hunt sometimes wasn't getting stopped by starting an exorcism
 Fixed a bug where interactions would completely stop
 Fixed a bug where some interactions would get stuck in place (This may still be happening in some areas of some maps, let me know in the Discord if you see it).
 Fixed a bug where it wasn't properly detecting certain exorcism items in the room
 Fixed a bug where it wasn't properly detecting if the player was holding the ghostwriting book
 Fixed the UI on wide-screen monitors
 Fixed a bug where the lighting was weird on Wilson Drive
 Fixed a bug where players would sometimes be a few seconds behind on co-op


Changes/QoL Improvements:


 You can now close menus with the escape key
 You can now skip the intro screen by pressing space
 You can now scroll to swap between equipment
 Significant performance improvements
 Significant networking improvements
 Reduced the starting intro volume
 Reduced blood rain volume
 Increased the rate of all interactions
 Decreased the flashlight range/brightness
 Added minor volumetric fog to all maps
 Increased the spirit box matryoshka doll talking range from 3 meters to 9 meters.
 Added a lot more keybindings, almost complete controller support now, the only thing you'll need to do is press 'B' occasionally.
 Removed the lighter from all the maps, to turn on the candles, just press your interact key while holding it.


Coming Soon:


 VOIP for lobbies.
 Final full controller support
 Significantly improved AI
 New map.


Thank you to everyone supporting me still, and helping by leaving such amazing reviews, or reporting bugs to me on Discord. You're all amazing people and are the only reason I've managed to get the game to the point it's currently at. I hope you all enjoy these changes you've been asking for and the new public lobbies!

notes.title: New Exorcism Mechanic (+ Bug Fixes + Changes)
notes.notes:
New Exorcism Mechanic

You can no longer "cheese" an exorcism by just stacking all the items on the bible and picking a ghost at random.

The exorcism will start as soon as the bible is placed and a ghost is selected, so I highly recommend that you place the bible last or it won't wait for you, and you'll be forced to quickly rush through the exorcism.

This means that if you've selected the ghost and put the bible down, the exorcism will start instantly, regardless of the items placed near it, they now all need to be set up and ready before placing the bible in the room, they're still required, and you will fail for wrong items (Holy Water + Salt if you required Holy Water + Chalice), this should fix a lot of the confusion with "exorcisms not starting" that people have been reporting to me, despite them just being wrong about the ghost.

Let me know what you think in the Discord, I love all your feedback and really want to improve the game with everyone <3

notes.title: Exorcism Changes (+ New Effigy Model + Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Exorcism Changes

After playing the game more myself, listening to reviewers, and everyone in the comments section, I felt the current exorcism was way too hard and was extremely unforgiving, it felt more tedious than fun, especially if you felt like you did everything correctly, just to get laughed at and eaten.

The new exorcism mechanic was actually recommended in the comment section of one of Insyms videos by someone that goes by the name Apex, their original idea was to make it percentage-based, meaning if you get 4/5 clues completed, you have an 80% chance of successfully completing the exorcism, rather than a 0% chance.

I've worked this idea into the game, while also factoring in the ghost selection step, selecting the correct ghost currently makes up for 40% of your success chance, meaning if you figure out the ghost, but don't try and get any clues and just start an exorcism, you have a 40% chance to be successful. This chance can and probably will be changed in the future through more testing, and with different difficulty levels, but that's the number I felt comfortable settling on currently.

The steps or "clues" make up an additional 60% of the success chance, so if you have to find only 1 clue, that 1 clue makes up 60% of your success chance, but if you have to find 6 clues, they're all 10% each, adding up to 60%.

I'm really happy with how this feels, but as I said, the numbers aren't currently set in stone, and I'm more than happy to revise them in the future after more feedback and testing.

New Effigy Model

As you all probably know, the current Effigy model was very much a placeholder, and none of us were really happy with it, it was more comical than scary which certainly isn't what we want. It also didn't feel like it fit with the Effigy, as he's meant to be the ghost of a man that died in a house fire at the house previously. I feel this model fits that significantly better, and I'm looking forward to seeing what you all think of it!
